name: Kyonyuu Hitozuma Onna Kyoushi Saimin - Keitai Appli de Sex Chuudoku!
original_name: 巨乳人妻女教師催眠・携帯アプリでセックス中毒！
source:
Morishita Wataru grew up on a motherless family, but despite his lonely environment, he worked hard and managed to enroll in the prestigious Ousei Academy. The school is run by an old scholarship rule, in which the students' grades are tied to the teacher's evaluation, so the teachers inevitably gives the students a strict education.

Morishita has good grades, but in a class where everyone is an excellent student, his grades were below-average. His homeroom teacher Tsukishima Kyouko was particularly strict on him, whenever if it's about his grades or even his daily life too. Morishita was very stressed between the difficult studies and the harsh teaching, but he had someone to help him: Shirakawa Miwa, a kind, maternal woman who is the assistant homeroom teacher of his class and understood Morishita's circumstances, all of this made Morishita developing romantic feelings towards her.

However, she suddenly announced her marriage, and Morishita who lost his friend and only moral support fell into despair. Naturally, he couldn't concentrate anymore on his studies and end up getting the lowest score on the scholarship test, leading to take special classes after school.

His stress was bigger than ever, now Miwa was going to become another man's wife and his grades lower than before. At this moment, his smartphone started to vibrate, and when Morishita checked it out of curiosity, there was an app he had never seen called "Hypnosis App" on the screen...
translation:
森下涉在没有母亲的家庭中长大，但尽管生活孤独，他仍努力学习，成功进入了名门Ousei学院。学校实行一项古老的奖学金制度，学生成绩与教师评价挂钩，因此教师不得不对学生进行严格教育。

森下的成绩不错，但在所有人都是优秀学生的班级里，他的成绩只能算中下游。他的班主任月岛响子尤其严格，无论是成绩还是日常生活都不放过。森下在艰苦学习和严厉管教之间承受着巨大压力，但还有一个人能帮助他：白河美和。她是个温柔、充满母性的女人，也是班级的副班主任，理解森下的处境。这一切让森下对她产生了恋爱感情。

然而，她突然宣布要结婚。失去朋友和唯一精神支柱的森下陷入绝望。自然，他再也无法专心学习，奖学金考试考出了最低分，只好在放学后参加特别课程。

他的压力达到了前所未有的程度：美和即将成为别人的妻子，而他的成绩也比以前更差。就在这时，他的智能手机开始震动。森下出于好奇查看屏幕，发现上面出现了一个从未见过的应用，名为“催眠应用”……
